purpose: Preview-only characters-combat style board for selecting a rugged painterly industrial direction before producing the player master asset.
facing: right-facing neutral masters in a fixed comparison grid
lighting: dusty cool cyan rim light, subtle magenta plane separation, localized warm orange emission
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: preview-only 2D game character style board. Create four isolated subjects in a clean fixed 2x2 comparison grid on a flat low-contrast black-blue field: top-left a compact player operative with cyan faction light and a separate warm-orange rifle; top-right a smaller Scrapper enemy with angular magenta salvage armor; bottom-left a massive Bruiser enemy with broad dark ceramic plates and restrained magenta energy; bottom-right a compact orange-white radial hit spark. Style direction B: rugged cyber-wasteland painterly concept art, layered oxidized scrap metal, dusty synthetic fabric, worn composite armor, visible repairs, broad confident brush shapes, strong silhouette with moderate internal texture. Consistent top-down three-quarter camera and neutral right-facing pose for all actors. No labels, no text, no borders, no scenery, no cropped anatomy, no loose cables, no acid green, no excessive bloom, no watermark.
negative_constraints: no noisy silhouette or dangling wires
no acid green in this preview
no excessive bloom or opaque halos
